records.text: Abyss Points: Stigma Shards first (KeenGamer).
Belt +10 (Rare) cost: 232,000 Kina and 9,280 Enhance Stones.
Five Daevanion boards on global: {boardList}; node costs 1 / 2 / 3 / 4.
Cash shop: mostly cosmetic, but consumables and Daeva Pass materials exist (MassivelyOP, games.gg).
Core skill-point order (Heart Gore, Insignia Explosion, Savage Roar, Quick Slice, Ambush, passives, Shadowstrike), ranked from per-level damage and cooldowns.
Vaizel and Triniel corner stats (Critical Damage Boost, Multi-Hit Chance), from each board's stat totals; Daevanion path costs.
Daevanion points: 4 per level past 11 (checked at 16 and 17).
Duty Quests open at 45, 5 a day per server; Supply Requests (25) are a separate system.
Expedition weekly reward cap: 7 per dungeon (Metabot, KeenGamer) vs removed (games.gg; KR/TW).
Expeditions: Urugugu Canyon 28 (item level 300, party 2–5) and Fire Temple 35 (item level 500); Conquest at 45.
Free-to-play: the Market and the Kina/Quna exchange need the $15 subscription.

First Daevanion nodes (Metabot's class build vs its board guide, couga54, GamesFuze); the guide blends them. Which core skill first: Heart Gore (Metabot, GamesFuze) or Quick Slice (games.gg, ExpCarry).
16 points to reach Heart Gore + Ambush on Nezekan.
Right-click row order and the E stack (buffs first).
Skill points per level 30–44 (Wikily; 203 at 45 has two sources).
Holding left click with the right-click macro keeps MP full.

Regional quests: giver, Kibelisk, rewards, recommended and unlock level from each quest's Metabot page; prerequisites (an earlier regional quest or a story quest) from aion2.gaming.tools and aion2.th.gl, cross-checked with allthings.how ({rqChained} follow-ups, {rqStoryGated} story-gated).
Respec: free while you level; whether it costs Kina after 31 (MeinMMO vs allthings.how, ExitLag).
Sealed Dungeons are solo; every sampled band pays 2 Wisdom Stones + 2 crystals on the first clear (Metabot, allthings.how, AION2HUB).
Skill points after the four above: {skillOrderSingle} (games.gg).
Skill points after the core eight: {skillOrderTwoSource} (GamesFuze, Skycoach). Per-level costs and gates from Metabot skill pages.
Specialty slots at skill level 8 / 12 / 20.
Stat tiers: only stats that at least two of Metabot, games.gg and GamesFuze rank high (order inside a tier varies).
Stigma slots 3 and 4: Swift Contract before Savage Fang (Metabot, Skycoach); GamesFuze has the reverse.
Stigma slots 22 / 27 / 32 / 37; every stigma learnable at 22; shard cost per level (Metabot, allthings.how). Upgrade plan: Triniel's Dagger to 10, then Illusive Clone toward 20 (GamesFuze, Skycoach).
Main story to "{storyEndQuest}" (Lv {storyEndLv}): objectives and Kibelisks from Metabot quest pages.
Stronghold level bands (zone plus the level range on Metabot's map).
Strongholds pay belt scrolls and Kina, no Wisdom Stones or crystals (Metabot quest pages, AION2HUB, allthings.how, FandomWire).
Supply Request details (request types, deadlines).
Unlock levels from the client-data table (Metabot, Wikily): enhancement 9; extraction, crafting, gathering 10; Supply Requests 25; daily dungeon 30; Abyss, Market, Ascension Trial, Conquest 45.
Kibelisk and Command mission unlock levels.
